बॉलीवुड प्रेमियों के लिए आई है एक धमाकेदार और चटपटी खबर! 💥

स्रोतों के मुताबिक एक्टर Mohitt Maalik अब Tiger Shroff के साथ फिल्म Vajr में विलेन के रोल में आमने-सामने नजर आएंगे। 🎬

Ram Madhvani के डायरेक्शन और Mahaveer Jain के प्रोडक्शन में बनने वाली यह फिल्म एक स्पिरिचुअल एक्शन एंटरटेनर होगी।

हाल ही में Birju Lohar के रोल से चर्चा में आए मोहित पहली बार टाइगर श्रॉफ के साथ स्क्रीन शेयर करने जा रहे हैं।

रिपोर्ट्स की मानें तो इस एक्शन से भरपूर फिल्म का मुख्य हिस्सा जापान की खूबसूरत लोकेशंस पर शूट किया जाएगा।

फिल्म में दोनों स्टार्स के बीच का जबरदस्त टकराव दर्शकों के लिए देखने लायक होगा। ✨

क्या आप Tiger Shroff और Mohitt Maalik की इस ऑन-स्क्रीन जंग को देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर दें! 👇

ctx.text:
Mohitt Maalik is set to take on a different on-screen role with his upcoming film Vajr , which features Tiger Shroff in the lead. According to sources, Mohitt will be seen playing the antagonist in the spiritual action entertainer, produced by Mahaveer Jain and directed by Ram Madhvani. While details about his character have been kept under wraps, the role is said to be an important part of the film's narrative. Sources also reveal that the film will be shot in Japan.
Mohitt recently drew attention for his portrayal of Birju Lohar, a character that became one of his widely discussed performances. With Vajr , the actor is now set to explore another distinct role, stepping into the antagonist space. The film's action-driven narrative will give him an opportunity to experiment with a different character and present another side of his acting.
Another aspect of the project that has generated interest is Mohitt's first-time collaboration with Tiger Shroff. Known for his action-oriented roles and screen presence, Tiger will share screen space with Mohitt in a film that is expected to feature several action sequences. Their on-screen equation is likely to be an important element of the narrative, with Mohitt's antagonist role setting up a conflict with the lead character.
Speaking about the project, a source close to the development shares, “Mohitt has an interesting character in Vajr . He will be playing an antagonist opposite Tiger Shroff, and it is a role that gives him an opportunity to explore a different space as an actor. After Birju Lohar, this is another distinct character for him. It will also be interesting to see Mohitt and Tiger share screen space for the first time, especially in a film that has action at its core.”
With Vajr , Mohitt Maalik is adding another project to his upcoming lineup. The film will see him move away from the kind of character he recently portrayed as Birju Lohar and take on a role with a different set of challenges. His collaboration with Tiger Shroff, along with the film's spiritual action backdrop and Japan schedule, adds to the interest surrounding the project. Further details about the film and the characters are awaited.
